_comment: Non-role address-kind registry (Ruling 13, de5d538f, thread f60b8eb4). Complements config/roles/roles.json: every registered to:-address is either a key under roles.json.roles (kind=role — the only kind carrying a delivery obligation) or a key under addresses here. kind=alias: accepted at write, never rejected; expansion-at-write is R13 Phase C, pending the architect's expansion-target decisions (DBA scoping record ab18534c §3). kind=telemetry: recorded for the historical record, never delivered, no inbox pointer, never a role. Non-role addresses must NOT be added to roles.json.roles (keys there must match tackle.roles exactly).

wr-conf-observer.description: Work-request-conf observer stream — ARCHIVAL telemetry. Recorded, never delivered; no inbox pointer; no harness/persona surfaces; do NOT register as a role; do NOT retag historical entries (retagging would flood a NULL-pointer mailbox).
wr-conf-observer.completionMarker: stream closed at the 2026-09-21 session-protocol boundary; all entries are immutable archival history — no delivery expected in any window
